summary: Created the Vite/React, Express, and FastAPI fixtures plus a 15-test unit suite; all three detect with pinned Railpack 0.43.0, server fixtures read PORT, and typecheck, lint, and the full test suite pass.

decisions: Pinned exact direct dependencies and Node major 24; no lockfiles were added, matching the fixture scope.
FastAPI server reads PORT via os.environ and also supports Railpack's generated uvicorn start command.
validationLimitations: Real Railpack/BuildKit image builds are deferred to the gated BLD-1.6 integration test; provider detection and local runtime behavior were verified here.
payload.taskDescription: Add three minimal, buildable fixture applications that the integration suite will own: a Vite/React static SPA that builds to static assets, an Express API that reads PORT and serves a JSON health response at /, and a FastAPI app that reads PORT and serves the same shape. Each fixture must be small, dependency-light, and pinned enough to build repeatedly. Add a unit test that asserts each fixture has its required entry files and that the Express and FastAPI fixtures read the PORT environment variable.
